purpose: Lightweight persistent editorial reasoning index used to avoid re-opening large analysis bundles unnecessarily.
workflow: Read this index first in every editorial session.
Read only the newly uploaded bundle evidence.
Persist the complete editorial reasoning for that bundle in its bundle_*_editorial_memory.json file.
Use all persisted bundle memories as the historical story pool.
Derive edit_timeline.json from the memory layer.
Do not silently replace an old bundle conclusion without documenting a superseding analysis.

generatedEvidence.purpose: Lightweight evidence layer generated locally from the analysis directory for LLM editorial reasoning.

reopenOldBundleOnlyWhen: required evidence is absent from memory
source identity or timestamp conflict is detected
a previous editorial conclusion is proven inconsistent with the evidence
